lines.text: Hi, I bought this mug here yesterday.
lines.speaker: Hui

lines.text: Is there a problem with it?
lines.speaker: Ava

lines.text: Yes, there's a crack near the handle.
lines.speaker: Hui

lines.text: I see it. Do you have the receipt?
lines.speaker: Ava

lines.text: Yes, here it is. Can I exchange it?
lines.speaker: Hui

lines.text: Yes. We have the same mug in yellow.
lines.speaker: Ava

lines.text: Do you have another blue one like this?
lines.speaker: Hui

lines.text: I'm afraid not. We only have yellow today.
lines.speaker: Ava
